papers_reviewed.title: Widespread retreat of coastal habitat is likely at warming levels above 1.5°C
key_findings: Deficit between mangrove adjustment and RSLR likely at 4 mm/yr
With 3°C warming, nearly all mangroves exposed to ≥7 mm/yr RSLR
Palaeo-stratigraphic observations align with contemporary measurements
papers_reviewed.relevance: Provides SLR thresholds for mangrove vulnerability (4 and 7 mm/yr)

papers_reviewed.title: Priority areas to protect mangroves and maximise ecosystem services
key_findings: 13.5% of mangrove distribution currently strictly protected
Optimising conservation to 30% could safeguard 16.3B USD property, 6.1M people, 1173.1 Tg C
Ecosystem services should be included in protected area design
papers_reviewed.relevance: Provides framework for ecosystem services valuation in mangrove conservation

papers_reviewed.title: Tropical cyclones and the organization of mangrove forests: a review
key_findings: Major TCs cause visible effects on mangroves
Recovery depends on storm intensity and prior stressors
Storm-based sediment subsidies important for recovery
papers_reviewed.relevance: Ecological basis for TC damage mechanisms on mangroves

papers_reviewed.title: Tropical cyclone risk to global mangrove ecosystems: potential future regional shifts
papers_reviewed.journal: Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment
key_findings: Risk hotspots: Gulf of Mexico/Caribbean, South Indian Ocean, NW Pacific
With 2°C warming, +3% global risk but substantial regional divergence
North America risk increases >10%, Oceania decreases >10%
papers_reviewed.relevance: Core methodology for TC risk index (TCDI, TCRI formulas)

papers_reviewed.title: Global vulnerability and resilience of coastal ecosystems to tropical cyclones in a warming climate
key_findings: 13% of terrestrial ecosystems susceptible to transformation from cyclone pattern changes
Average storm interval projected to decrease from 19 to 12 years
IPCC climate risk framework applied to ecosystem vulnerability
papers_reviewed.relevance: Framework for combining TC frequency/intensity changes with ecosystem vulnerability
